answer: Co-spend tracing: each payout lands as a terrace of 10 locked tranches, one unlocking per epoch. If coins from two IDs ever meet in one spend (shared input or same destination within 10 epochs), both IDs are linked and their still-locked tranches burn. A 1,000-clone farm sweeping to one wallet forfeits up to 90% of earnings (proposed, not measured). Honest agents keep an oasis of steady unlocks; a farm wallet is an opal: shiny on the explorer, cracked by one sweep.
